==================
__has_warning with a string operand
==================

#if __has_warning("-Wunguarded-availability-new")
    #define AF_CAN_USE_AT_AVAILABLE 1
#else
    #define AF_CAN_USE_AT_AVAILABLE 0
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (string_literal
          (string_content))))
    (preproc_def
      (identifier)
      (preproc_arg))
    (preproc_else
      (preproc_def
        (identifier)
        (preproc_arg)))))

==================
__has_include with angle and quoted operands
==================

#if __has_include(<UIKit/UITraitCollection.h>) && !SD_WATCH
#import <UIKit/UITraitCollection.h>
#endif

#if __has_include("SDWebImageCompat.h")
#import "SDWebImageCompat.h"
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (binary_expression
      (call_expression
        (identifier)
        (argument_list
          (system_lib_string)))
      (unary_expression
        (identifier)))
    (preproc_include
      (system_lib_string)))
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (string_literal
          (string_content))))
    (preproc_include
      (string_literal
        (string_content)))))

==================
NS_ENUM fallback macro definitions
==================

#ifndef NS_ENUM
#define NS_ENUM(_type, _name) enum _name : _type _name; enum _name : _type
#endif

#ifndef NS_OPTIONS
#define NS_OPTIONS(_type, _name) enum _name : _type _name; enum _name : _type
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_ifdef
    (preproc_function_def
      (preproc_params
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (preproc_arg)))
  (preproc_ifdef
    (preproc_function_def
      (preproc_params
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (preproc_arg))))

==================
ifdef around a property inside an interface
==================

@interface User : NSObject

@property (readonly, nonatomic, assign) NSUInteger userID;
#ifdef __MAC_OS_X_VERSION_MIN_REQUIRED
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSImage *profileImage;
#endif

@end

---

(translation_unit
  (class_interface
    (identifier)
    (identifier)
    (property_declaration
      (property_attributes_declaration
        (property_attribute
          (identifier))
        (property_attribute
          (identifier))
        (property_attribute
          (identifier)))
      (struct_declaration
        (type_identifier)
        (struct_declarator
          (identifier))))
    (preproc_ifdef
      (identifier)
      (property_declaration
        (property_attributes_declaration
          (property_attribute
            (identifier))
          (property_attribute
            (identifier)))
        (struct_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (struct_declarator
            (pointer_declarator
              (identifier))))))))

==================
ifdef around a method definition inside an implementation
==================

@implementation Foo

#ifdef FOO
- (void)bar {
}
#endif

@end

---

(translation_unit
  (class_implementation
    (identifier)
    (implementation_definition
      (preproc_ifdef
        (identifier)
        (implementation_definition
          (method_definition
            (method_type
              (type_name
                (primitive_type)))
            (identifier)
            (compound_statement)))))))
